subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

He is famous / about his research / in the field of / astrophysics.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'about his research'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in **'about his research'.**
 
• The given sentence has an error of **'Preposition'.**
 
• So, replacing preposition** 'about'** with **'for'** will make the sentence correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is:** 'Option 4'.**

**Correct sentence**__: *He is famous /** for **his research / in the field of / astrophysics. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'****in the field of'** is the correct part of the sentence.
 
• **'He is famous'** is the correct part of the sentence.
 
• **'astrophysics'** is the correct part of the sentence.
